title: Cancer Free (Chas McIvor)
style: acoustic folk fingerpicked guitar quiet warm baritone male vocal 96bpm gentle brushed drums true story family relief honest unhurried intimate character portrait
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar, very quiet, barely there]
May 2022.
A phone.
A message.
Six words.

[Verse 1]
Kerry had the call yesterday
From the doctor
And she is cancer free
That's what Joel sent
Not a paragraph
Not an explanation
Not even punctuation beyond the period
Just the fact
The most important fact
Of that entire year

[Verse 2]
Corey got it
Read it
The kind of reading you do twice
Before you let it be true
Six words that carry six months
Or more
Of whatever went before
That the message doesn't say
Because the message doesn't need to
Because cancer free is the whole sentence

[Chorus]
Cancer free
Kerry
Cancer free
The call came through
Cancer free
The word the doctor used
Cancer free
Joel sent six words
That were the whole story
Cancer free
Kerry
Cancer free

[Bridge - spoken, simple, no decoration]
We don't know what came before.
What the months looked like.
What the mornings were like
when the result wasn't in yet.
We know what came after.
Six words.
A message to a brother
who was somewhere far away
and would want to know.
Joel knew to tell him.
That's what brothers are for.
Cancer free.
The rest is private.
The fact is for everyone.

[Chorus reprise]
Cancer free
Kerry
Cancer free
And the family went on from there
Cancer free
The way families go on
When the fact arrives
And the fact is good

[Outro - guitar alone, breathing]
May thirteenth
Twenty twenty two
Kerry
Cancer free
The doctor called
Joel texted
Corey answered
Awesome good
That is correct
Awesome
Good
